q: The Syracuse function Syr: 2ℤ+1 → 2ℤ+1 maps odd n ↦ (3n+1)/2^{v₂(3n+1)}. Its connection to the 2-adic integers ℤ₂ = lim_{←} ℤ/2^nℤ: the Collatz conjecture is equivalent to stating that for every odd n ∈ ℤ⁺, the sequence Syr^k(n):
opts: Eventually reaches 1 (the unique positive integer fixed point)
exp: Collatz conjecture ↔ every positive odd integer eventually maps to 1 under Syr. In ℤ₂, there are other fixed points and cycles (e.g., the negative integers give cycles like −1 → −1). The conjecture concerns the orbit of positive integers specifically.
